user_steering: Broaden benchmark coverage and gradually raise evidentiary standards toward a paper.
principle: Raise the evidentiary support needed for stronger research claims; do not retroactively add answer requirements, convert optional omissions into errors, or redefine failure to increase the count.

breadth_plan.counting_unit: Distinct source-backed benchmark-centered scientific-claim families with actual recommendation answers; variants/paraphrases/repeats and incidental benchmark names are not additional families.
breadth_plan.later_wave_selection_rule: Select for new construct/data/metric/decision coverage and source-review capacity, not only because an earlier output failed. Freeze later cases and selection rule before later responses.

current_block.condition: Baseline existing-knowledge recommendation only; no source intervention or held-out paraphrases in this 60-call allocation.
current_block.requires_final_root_freeze: Root must freeze final casepack, exact 60-row payload manifest, model IDs, common response budget/settings/transport, source criteria, source-snapshot hashes, allocation/order and stopping before subject calls.
current_block.retention: Each frozen client request once; retain all HTTP errors/timeouts/incomplete/empty captures as unscorable, with no silent replacement.
current_block.analysis: Keep discovery screen and selected-case replication separate; no pooled population error rate or general model ranking. Repeated calls are clustered within source case/configuration.

stages.label: screened_observation
minimum_evidence: One interpretable material unsupported endorsement under a frozen case/rubric, with exact answer bytes and decisive primary source or explicit logical warrant
Two independent first reviews; scope disputes retained and resolved separately or kept uncertain
stages.allowed_claim: A case-specific unsupported recommendation was observed in this recorded configuration/context.
stages.sampling: Breadth screen: one request per new case/configuration; all frozen rows attempted once.

stages.label: initial_replication_signal
minimum_evidence: Prospectively frozen three fresh contexts per selected original case/configuration
At least two yes labels among three scorable, complete new answers in that cell; report the exact numerator, all attempted rows and all four outcome labels
stages.threshold_status: Heuristic descriptive prioritization flag, not statistical significance, publication certification or a cutoff that invalidates one-off observations.
stages.incomplete_rule: If fewer than three answers are scorable, label operationally incomplete; do not compute the flag using a smaller completed denominator or replace missing calls.
stages.allowed_claim: The original wording produced a recurrent error in this three-context configuration-specific block.

stages.label: five_context_replication_characterized
minimum_evidence: A separately frozen extension fixes exactly two more contexts for the prespecified selected cells, reaching five new attempts per cell
A 3-of-5 complete/scorable yes pattern may be flagged as frequent within this small selected-cell sample; report 1/5 or 2/5 errors too without suppressing them
stages.threshold_status: A practical evidence-strength descriptor only; no inferential claim or automatic paper-acceptance threshold.
stages.incomplete_rule: If fewer than five answers are scorable, report attempted and completed denominators and refrain from the five-complete-context flag.
stages.allowed_claim: A selected-case repeated-context result, with observed variability and exact counts.
stages.sampling: No stop-at-the-first-failure, retry-until-success or top-up only until a desired count. Later extension selection and allocation must be frozen before extension outputs.
stages.extension_allocation_default: Prefer extending all 12 prespecified selected-case/configuration cells by exactly two requests each regardless of the first three outcomes: 24 additional attempts, outside current60. Any adaptive subset must be declared with its selection rule; preserve first-block and extension counts separately, and do not infer an unbiased frequency from their selected pooled result.

stages.label: wording_transfer_observed
minimum_evidence: The six held-out wording probes pass independent fidelity review before sampling
A separate frozen transfer block attempts each probe across all four model-family configurations once: 3 cases × 2 probes × 4 configurations = 24 attempts
An error on original wording and at least one held-out wording for the same source case/configuration permits a narrow observed-transfer statement
stages.allowed_claim: The same material mismatch was observed under more than one meaning-preserving wording for this selected case.

stages.label: within_case_wording_recurrence
minimum_evidence: A separately frozen repeated-probe block, with three fresh contexts per each of the two probe wordings in selected prespecified cells
At least two yes among three complete/scorable answers for each of the two probe wordings in a cell can support a narrow within-case wording-recurrence descriptor
stages.threshold_status: Optional higher descriptive bar. This is not included in the current 60-call block or the one-shot 24-attempt transfer screen.
stages.sampling: If run for all four configurations and all three cases, 3 cases × 2 wordings × 4 configurations × 3 repeats = 72 additional attempts. Retain all cells and failures, not only adverse ones.

stages.label: decision_consequence_tested
minimum_evidence: Freeze actual candidate systems or immutable published outputs, exact inference/scoring/data/reference versions, any label adapter, target construct and tie/selection rule
Separate selection evidence from an independent target holdout; report every eligible candidate and prespecified comparison
Report whether following the recommendation changes selection and the selected candidates' target-score differences with uncertainty
stages.promotion_to_consequence_demonstrated: Use this stronger label only if an actual measured selection or target-outcome consequence is observed under the frozen design. A logical/synthetic illustration alone does not qualify.
stages.null_rule: No selection change is a valid consequence-test result, not a reason to search arbitrary new pairs until a reversal appears. A paper may report repeated wrong-fit advice with a null or unmeasured consequence, using the appropriate narrow claim.
not_established: Real-world user adoption or harm without a separately designed user study
An intrinsic benchmark defect from recommendation misuse alone

stages.label: paper_ready_claim_scope
minimum_evidence: Human review of source-case definitions, all claimed material failures and disputed scopes, plus a prespecified sample of aligned/qualified answers; preserve independent judgments
Current primary-source related-work check and a clearly stated incremental contribution; no first-ever mechanism or benchmark-defect claim merely because a new output was observed
Reproducible artifacts, raw answers and all operational failures/nulls, frozen protocols, exact available model identity/settings and candid missing-snapshot limits
Paper claims explicitly match the strongest stage actually attained; dates separate prior preparation and event-day work
stages.human_scope: One human reviewer supplies human validation of that scope, not inter-human reliability. Two independent humans on a declared subset would be needed to describe inter-human agreement; if unavailable, say so.
stages.no_automatic_gate: Research can continue while human review is pending. Do not label agent reviews as human validation or block all reversible experimentation waiting for an optional approval.
stages.consequence_not_mandatory_for_every_pape: A defensible paper can be scoped to replicated case studies and a reproducible recommendation audit; an actual ranking reversal is required only for a claimed reversal, not for all possible papers.

cross_stage_rules: All thresholds are declared descriptive heuristics unless a separate statistical estimand/design and inferential procedure are preregistered; small n never becomes significance by naming a threshold.
Freeze complete additional allocations before sampling. Operational errors are not epistemic recommendation failures and cannot silently shrink denominators.
Two same-family agent judgments can be correlated. Preserve disagreements, exact evidence and adjudication identity/timing; human remains pending until actually done.
Correct recommendations, accurately bounded proxies, appropriate uncertainty/abstention and null consequence tests remain in the archive and analysis.
Do not promote an ambiguous scope to yes merely to satisfy a stage threshold. Keep unresolved interpretations uncertain.
A supplied balanced primary-source card tests an evidence-plus-instruction package. Actual autonomous retrieval needs separately observed source access; neither is browsing-only causation by default.
Treat exact returned aliases and API controls as recorded. Do not claim immutable provider checkpoints or cross-interface comparability without evidence.
A transfer wording is not a new benchmark family. A changed scenario requirement or criterion is a new variant/amendment, not a meaning-preserving paraphrase.

If extension eligibility uses earlier observed outcomes, explicitly report adaptive post-selection; freezing later payloads alone does not undo that selection. Prefer allocation rules that extend every original selected cell regardless of its observed error count.

historical_status_readout_not_regrading.status: Observed in earlier cohorts and repeated for one configuration on the original wording; native API observations and evidence-package results exist under different interfaces. Human pending. Do not pool them as one common sampling experiment.
One observed complete API recommendation with two original yes ratings and a separate mechanism check; no stochastic replication or measured selection reversal yet.
One observed complete API recommendation; first ratings disagreed, separate model-blind scope review and coordinator disposition marked yes; human pending and no repetition yet.
Keep uncertain pending human scope review, not a definite failure or a promoted discovery.
No ranking reversal among eligible archive identifiers; provenance gaps remain. Preserve as a null feasibility check.
